title: BSU student studies at a university in Cyprus through academic mobility

blocks.text: Guljamal Kudashbekova, a second-year student at the Faculty of Ecology and Management of Bishkek State University, studied at Aydin University (Cyprus) in the autumn semester of the 2025–2026 academic year through an academic mobility programme. She successfully passed her midterm examinations, demonstrated strong academic results, actively participated in cultural and educational events, and represented Bishkek State University with distinction internationally.
